Build North · Reality Check · design work, October 20 and 21, 2026

Every design so far

Six rounds, oldest first: the research, the first app screens, two rounds of Socratic directions, Plaster to Bronze (the direction built from what the app means) Out of the Cave, which mixes the picks from rounds 3 to 5 into one direction, and Pivot Directions, made after the user narrowed to CS students who build with coding agents. Round 6 is the app's theme in #81; round 7 shows six ways the look could follow the new user, and round 8, Open Box, mixes four of them into one direction in a blue theme and a black theme.

Each round is also saved as its own file next to this one, with its images.

Round 1

Design research

Three style directions with a reason for every color, six annotated references, and the research behind the colors.

Standalone file: 01-research/design-research.html

Round 2

Ink & Highlighter

The four app screens (predict, a hint, level 5, result) plus a small phone and dark mode, with a contrast check.

Standalone file: 02-ink-and-highlighter/ink-and-highlighter-mockups.html

Round 3

Socratic, with photos

Six directions from the Socratic moodboard (engraving, marble, chiaroscuro, fresco, collage, old master), each with a splash and a result screen.

Standalone file: 03-socratic-photo/socratic-photo-directions.html

Round 4

Socratic, abstract

Six directions drawn in code (Byrne’s Euclid, black-figure pottery, Plato’s cave, verde marble, the Ionic order, Euler circles), each with its own picture of the calibration gap.

Standalone file: 04-socratic-abstract/socratic-abstract-directions.html

Round 5

Plaster to Bronze

The direction built from the app’s meaning: Rodin’s Thinker, plaster for what you felt sure of, bronze for what you proved, across six screens.

Standalone file: 05-plaster-to-bronze/plaster-to-bronze.html

Round 6

Out of the Cave

The mix: Plato’s Cave, Chiaroscuro, Fresco, Old Master and Plaster to Bronze in one direction, refined with Apple’s design principles. Every session walks from the dark (what you feel sure of) into daylight (what you proved). Includes the brand kit for #14.

Standalone file: 06-out-of-the-cave/out-of-the-cave.html

Round 7

Pivot Directions

Six directions for CS students who build with coding agents, next to the current app: Cave for Code, Red to Green, Whiteboard, Black Box, Your Pair and Warm Editor, on Android-size screens.

Standalone file: 07-pivot-directions/pivot-directions.html

Round 8

Open Box

One direction mixed from 7B, 7D, 7E and 7F: the session as a test run, the box that opens one corner per proved point, the pair that asks, and the tutor's serif voice. Shown in two color themes, Cobalt (blue and white) and Obsidian (black and white), each with a day and a night mode.

Standalone file: 08-open-box/open-box.html
